5_candidate_reasoning.question: AI risk review — why does this edge exist, and what could go wrong?
5_candidate_reasoning.finding: [CAUTION] The claimed edge is fragmented local supply (only 4 named providers) against 300 monthly demand events, but the ledger gives no reason this niche is underserved — Airbnb turnover cleaning is a low-barrier service, so the 'mispricing' may simply reflect that incumbents already absorb the demand. Risks: Regulatory: short-term rental (STR) of condos under 30 days is largely illegal in Thailand under the Hotel Act; a business built on Airbnb turnover could see its entire client base shut down or fined. · Labor/operations: a solo operator cannot physically clean 300 turnovers/mo without hiring staff — work-permit and Thai labor-hire constraints for a foreigner are unaddressed. · Demand quality unknown: '300 demand events/mo, 0% growth' from a single serper source may be search hits, not paying-customer intent or contracted jobs. · Incumbent response: four established local providers (khunclean, simply.co.th) can undercut or lock in condo-building relationships quickly. · Missing: Actual realized job volume and per-clean price for this area, not search-derived demand events, Legal status / permit requirements for a foreign solo operator to run a cleaning service and hire staff in Thailand, Whether target condos permit legal short-term rentals (Hotel Act compliance), Basis for the $572.40 net profit figure — per what unit/timeframe, and cost of labor and supplies, Competitor pricing and whether they already have exclusive building contracts
